content:
Apple today released a new round of public beta updates, including iPadOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, and more. Here's a look at the new features.

Apple 釋出 iPadOS、watchOS 27.2 等系統嘅 27.2 公開測試版

It has been an eventful week for Apple software releases. Last Monday, Apple rolled out major new software versions for all users, including:

Then on Wednesday, Apple unexpectedly rolled out 27.2 developer updates across its entire lineup of platforms. 27.1 is reportedly set to be skipped in the beta cycle, as this version focuses primarily on iPhone Duo-related changes. Beta 2 debuted yesterday, but remains limited to developers.

And today, public beta testers can get an early look at Apple's new 27.2 update.

Public betas for iPadOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, and more are now available. The build matches developer Beta 2. The most notable changes are in iPadOS and iOS.

iPadOS 27.2 ships with a brand-new Health app featuring Apple Intelligence capabilities, including Insights and Longevity sections, among others. It also brings Profiles to the Apple TV app — a long-awaited feature for parents whose kids watch videos on iPad.

This update also adds a handy Siri AI feature previously only available on macOS Golden Gate. Siri AI has also expanded language support to include new countries.

If you'd like to install today's public beta, head to Settings → Software Update and make sure you've enrolled in the beta program.

Have you installed the new 27.2 public beta yet? How's it running so far? Drop your thoughts in the comments.
